checks.description: Avoid: At review a 'Plan continuity & priority care' line (₹149 + GST folded in = ₹175.82) is added, controlled by a pressed toggle button that starts on, with a small 'Remove' link. The line does not exist on the pricing page (appears from review) and the price shows only in the order summary.
Avoid: The review opt-in now asks to share usage and email with partner studios and starts ticked, wrapped in tutorial/offers wording.

Avoid: On the free-trial path, review requires a card check that fails on first click with a gateway error; the primary button switches to the paid plan. 'Try again' (link) works. Paid path has no check.
